name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.

Modern Floating Capsule Dock: Redesigned bottom navigation into a floating pill dock (Echo Music style) with rounded corners, proper elevation above Android 3-button system bars, and zero edge-to-edge cutoff.
Strict Zero Glow on AMOLED: Completely eliminated blurry neon glows and hazy box-shadows on buttons, inputs, and active nav tabs in AMOLED mode. Active items are now cleanly and sharply colored.

Authentic Frosted Glassmorphism: Unlocked genuine liquid glass cards with real backdrop blur (28px) and specular top gloss rims floating over dynamic luminous ambient light blooms (matching Echo Music reference).
Cosmic Cyber Aurora: Restored vibrant teal & magenta radiant aurora curtains with iridescent holographic card highlights.
Flawless Light & Dark Modes: Full contrast audit ensuring every surface, badge, card, and text is crystal clear in both bright daylight and dark environments.
